working_memory.text: The wooden signal box at Ashcombe station, unused since the line was resignalled in 1987, has been restored by a group of volunteers and will open to visitors on summer weekends. The frame of thirty-two levers still works, though it is no longer connected to anything on the line, and visitors can pull levers under supervision. The volunteers raised the money for the roof through a raffle and a grant from the parish. The station remains in normal use, with trains every half hour.
